formulas.contrast_pass_count: count true tests among max_point_wind_kmh<63, abs(sentinel1_mean_db)<1, alphaearth_mean_change<0.05
formulas.rain_pass_count: count true tests among regional_peak_floor_mm>=254, central_park_record_hour_mm>=75, wettest_6h_mm>=75, six_hour_share>=0.60, city_report_total>=400, top3_borough_share>=0.75
formulas.wet_run_hours: longest contiguous run of hourly precipitation > 0

criteria.description: Returns the six requested top-level fields with threshold_counts nested as specified.
criteria.name: JSON shape
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points if the answer includes most required fields but has minor nesting, naming, or extra-text problems; award 0 if the required ledger is not recoverable.

criteria.description: Computes 133.9 mm event total, 98.3 mm wettest 6-hour load, 0.734 six-hour share, and 23 wet-run hours.
criteria.name: Hourly rainfall calculations
criteria.partial_credit: Award about 1 point for each correct rainfall quantity, with small rounding tolerance; lose the relevant credit for wrong aggregation windows, unit mistakes, or treating trace-zero hours as wet.

criteria.description: Evaluates all six rain thresholds from report, hourly rainfall, and city record values.
criteria.name: Rain thresholds
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit in proportion to correctly evaluated rain tests; lose credit for missing the inch-to-mm conversion, using the wrong threshold, or miscounting the six-test pass total.

criteria.description: Evaluates wind, Sentinel-1 mean VV change, and AlphaEarth mean change checks correctly.
criteria.name: Contrast thresholds
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point per correctly evaluated contrast test; lose credit for using the signed Sentinel-1 value instead of its absolute magnitude or reversing a less-than comparison.

criteria.description: Applies the threshold-count rule and returns rainfall_concentration_signature_supported.
criteria.name: Final state
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points if the final label is consistent with one threshold count but the other count or the rule wording is partly wrong; award 0 for the opposite final state.

criteria.description: Shows enough formula work to audit rounding and inch-to-mm conversion.
criteria.name: Formula trace
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 point for a mostly clear trace with one missing conversion or rounding note; award 0 if no calculation path is shown.

criteria.description: Does not convert service records into verified flood depth or mean image summaries into a complete inundation map.
criteria.name: No overstatement
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 point if the answer has one minor over-broad phrase but keeps the computed ledger intact; award 0 for adding major realized-loss or full-map conclusions beyond the computed values.
